perspective_summary: The defensible first-paper hypothesis is narrow: under the frozen synthetic episode protocol, the case-matched patient-excluded M0 may contain incremental information about the six-way legal intent label, especially target and scope, beyond the identical signed scribble, geometry, and non-M0 inputs. Its strongest alternative is cue-and-generator sufficiency: polarity, morphology, image context, eligibility rules, and construction artifacts already determine the label, while M0 contributes no unique held-out patient-level information. Even a positive full-versus-no_M0 contrast would establish predictive dependence under this protocol, not that M0 causally creates intent or that real human cognition follows the same mechanism, because residuals and scribbles are themselves constructed from M0 and reference labels. The minimum admissible intervention is the canonical simple-first full versus exhaustive no_M0 information ablation, with every other path fixed and evaluated at patient level, plus prespecified ambiguity-stratified diagnostics. Promoting cross-attention to the first-paper primary would be scope drift; it remains future work only. Exact downstream bundle/F0 closure is the first blocker, and the committed OOF M0 set must not be rerun.

observations.statement: The causal claim must be limited to incremental predictive information under the frozen synthetic protocol. Full outperforming no_M0 cannot by itself show that M0 causes intent, that the model recovered a human cognitive mechanism, or that the relationship generalizes beyond protocol-generated labels.

The episode construction induces a load-bearing causal path: reference label and M0 determine FN/FP residuals; residual type determines signed scribble and eligibility; the episode builder assigns an intent label. Conditioning on selected residual-derived episodes and then supplying both the scribble and M0 can create built-in statistical dependence between M0 and the label even if no human state-relative interpretation exists. This is protocol decoding or selection dependence unless a discriminating analysis rules out the construction explanation.

Positive FN-derived scribbles encode ADD and negative FP-derived scribbles encode REMOVE. An effect concentrated on the operation head is therefore a polarity shortcut and is not distinguishing evidence for state-relative intent; the load-bearing signal must appear on the legal joint and target and/or scope after holding polarity fixed.

Centerline, random, and boundary generation rules can make stroke length, boundary contact, component count, location, or support size predictive of target and scope. If geometry or morphology nearly determines a label, full-versus-no_M0 measures exploitation of generator regularity rather than interpretation of the current segmentation state.

M0 volume, component count, confidence, residual burden, or boundary complexity may act as a generic case-difficulty and generator-selection proxy. A full-arm gain can therefore arise from class-prior or difficulty calibration rather than relational reasoning about whether the same mark means SAME versus NEW or LOCAL versus COMPLETE.

PETCT-INTENT-v2.0 has six legal joints and forbids both NEW_LOCAL joints. Consequently scope is structurally COMPLETE whenever target is NEW; scope dependence is not separately identifiable in the NEW stratum, and a legality mask can improve joint scores without learning state-relative scope. Scope evidence must therefore be localized to SAME episodes, while target evidence must be examined among COMPLETE episodes where SAME and NEW are both legal.

The full-versus-no_M0 contrast is an information-ablation estimand, not the total causal effect of an actual segmentation state. Because the observed scribble is downstream of M0, no_M0 still receives a child of M0. The contrast can estimate whether explicit M0 adds predictive information conditional on that child, but cannot isolate all causal pathways from state to the constructed episode label.

Removing only the visible M0 channel is insufficient if state-support masks, pooled supports, residual-derived sampling strata, cached embeddings, normalization statistics, filenames, padding patterns, or episode metadata retain M0 information. Any such path makes no_M0 an exposed arm and invalidates the mechanistic contrast.

A no_M0 implementation can change input scale, missingness tokens, effective parameter opportunity, normalization, convergence, or regularization. Conversely, a poorly optimized full arm can hide useful state information. The arms must share tensor shape, code path, initialization policy, optimizer, schedule, stopping, checkpoint selection, and budget; otherwise the comparison is architecture or optimization mismatch rather than access to M0.

Episodes, scribbles, lesions, voxels, and cases from one patient are correlated and cannot be treated as independent evidence. Split assignment, paired arm comparison, aggregation, resampling, confidence intervals, and any permutation test must use the patient as the unit.

Using final-test patients to set atlas thresholds, class balancing, episode eligibility, ambiguity bins, hyperparameters, checkpoint selection, or a smallest relevant effect would leak outcomes into the design. Patient/exam aliases, duplicate studies, multiple episodes, and case-to-M0 mismatches are additional leakage routes even though upstream M0 is patient-excluded.

Registration error, scanner or acquisition differences, label-version differences, longitudinal duplicates, and complete-case selection may correlate with both M0 failure patterns and intent-class availability. These variables are unverified and can produce an apparent state effect or erase a real one unless provenance and physical-coordinate checks close them.

The six-way problem is not identifiable if any legal joint has inadequate distinct-patient support or if polarity or geometry deterministically partitions target or scope. The FN/FP atlas must expose patient counts and cross-tabs before training; sparse or deterministic cells require a stop, not post hoc class merging or a feasibility claim.

The canonical first-paper primary is the simple 17-channel state/cue model with state/cue-support pooling, geometry MLP, and joint/operation/target/scope heads; its primary contrast is full versus no_M0. Promoting cross-attention to the primary, using it to rescue an unfavorable result, or retrospectively redefining the contrast is scope drift. Cross-attention is allowed only as a separately registered deferred ablation or future work after the canonical result is frozen.

The first operational blocker is exact downstream deployed-bundle and F0 closure after the stale-bundle failure. The committed set of 597 cases from 378 patients, with exactly one patient-excluded OOF M0 prediction per eligible case, is an immutable upstream input and must not be rerun to repair this downstream failure.

No v2 six-class P2T/editor training, inference, metric, effect estimate, comparator result, or publication conclusion exists. All hypotheses, mechanisms, expected signals, thresholds to be frozen, and interventions in this contribution are design objects and must not be reported as empirical findings or live-resource status.

proposed_mechanisms.description: Narrow H_state mechanism for the frozen first-paper interface: explicit access to the case-matched OOF M0 allows the simple model to interpret the same signed cue relative to the current segmentation and thereby reduce patient-level error on target, scope where identifiable, and the six-way legal joint. This is a protocol-level information hypothesis, not a claim that state causes human intent.
inputs: frozen canonical 17-channel state/cue tensor with a closed channel and provenance manifest
case-matched patient-excluded OOF M0 and every declared M0-derived support path
identical signed scribble, cue support, and centerline/random/boundary geometry descriptors
identical non-M0 image and context inputs
PETCT-INTENT-v2.0 label constrained to the six legal joints; both NEW_LOCAL joints excluded
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: Use the unchanged simple-first backbone, state-support and cue-support pooling, frozen geometry MLP, and frozen joint/operation/target/scope heads. In full, declared M0 information is available. In no_M0, exhaustively neutralize only those declared direct and derived state paths while preserving shapes, code paths, non-M0 inputs, optimization, and compute. Evaluate paired predictions on an identical patient-level episode manifest.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: After bundle/F0, coverage, parity, and leakage gates pass, the prespecified patient-level full-minus-no_M0 improvement is positive for the primary legal-joint endpoint and is coherent on target and on scope within SAME episodes. The separation is largest in polarity-and-geometry-matched ambiguity strata; an operation-only gain is not a distinguishing signal.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: The mechanism is falsified for this interface if no_M0 matches or exceeds full under the locked patient-level analysis after validity gates pass, or if an aggregate gain disappears in ambiguity strata and is confined to polarity, geometry, legality masking, or difficulty-proxy strata. It is merely uninterpretable, not falsified, if M0 paths leak into no_M0, arms differ in training opportunity, legal-joint coverage is inadequate, or patient and provenance gates fail. Cross-attention may not be introduced as a rescue.

proposed_mechanisms.description: Strongest alternative H_cue: signed polarity, scribble morphology and geometry, non-M0 image context, episode eligibility, and legality constraints encode all practically available label information. M0 adds no unique held-out patient-level information once these variables are fixed.
inputs: all non-M0 image and cue-support inputs shared with full
episode-construction strata and six-joint legality constraint
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: The frozen no_M0 arm uses the same simple-first model and training procedure while state information is exhaustively neutralized. Existing polarity-blind and geometry-only diagnostic arms, plus predeclared matched-stratum analyses, localize whether cue sign or generator geometry accounts for prediction without replacing the primary comparison.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: Full and no_M0 are equivalent within a margin frozen before outcome access, especially in ambiguity strata; geometry-only retains target/scope/joint behavior when the generator exposes it; polarity-blind primarily affects operation. This pattern favors protocol-cue sufficiency rather than state-relative interpretation.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: This alternative cannot be preferred if no_M0 is a malformed or undertrained ablation, if residual M0 paths remain, or if equivalence is asserted from a low-power or coverage-deficient dataset. A valid, reproducible full advantage on target/scope/joint in ambiguity strata would contradict cue sufficiency, but still would not prove human cognition.

proposed_mechanisms.description: Competing non-semantic mechanism: M0 exposes residual burden, object count, lesion size, uncertainty, acquisition subgroup, or other case-difficulty features correlated with generated intent labels. The full model can then improve calibration or class priors without relationally interpreting the scribble against the state.
inputs: M0-derived global size, component, confidence, or support statistics
patient, acquisition, label-version, and missingness covariates when legitimately available for audit only
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: The episode generator selects FN/FP residuals and labels from cases whose M0 error structure differs. A model can map global state or correlated acquisition features to class prevalence without using spatial state-cue relations. Test this explanation through prespecified patient-level ambiguity strata and error/difficulty strata using the same canonical predictions, never by adding a new primary architecture.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: An apparent aggregate full advantage concentrates in coarse difficulty, volume, acquisition, or class-frequency strata and does not persist when polarity, geometry, episode type, and ambiguity are matched; spatially relevant target/scope errors do not improve coherently.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: This alternative is weakened if the full advantage persists on target/scope/joint within adequately supported, polarity-and-geometry-matched ambiguity strata and is not explained by state size, residual burden, patient subgroup, legality suppression, or selection artifacts. Such evidence would support incremental relational information only within the synthetic protocol.

experiments.comparison: Before any v2 training, compare the frozen episode and provenance manifests against a preregistered causal-validity table: six legal-joint patient support, zero NEW_LOCAL records, polarity-by-operation determinism, geometry/morphology-by-target/scope predictability, controlled-versus-natural mix, case-to-M0 binding, patient identity, physical-coordinate alignment, and direct plus derived M0 paths in each arm.
held_constant: committed 597-case/378-patient OOF M0 set with no rerun or candidate substitution
PETCT-INTENT-v2.0 definitions and exactly six legal joints
frozen episode-generation code after exact downstream bundle/F0 closure
patient as the split, aggregation, and resampling unit
coverage, leakage, determinism, and ambiguity thresholds frozen before model outcomes are inspected
experiments.observable: Produce distinct-patient counts per legal joint; cross-tabs of polarity, geometry family, stroke morphology, episode type, M0/residual burden, target, and scope; duplicate and split-overlap counts; exactly-one case-to-OOF-M0 provenance checks; zero forbidden input paths; and a closed declaration of every direct or derived M0 feature. Identify whether target or scope has within-stratum variation after matching cue variables, including scope only among SAME episodes and target among COMPLETE episodes.
experiments.falsifier: Stop before training if any legal joint misses the predeclared distinct-patient support threshold, either NEW_LOCAL joint appears, an unintended field deterministically exposes target or scope, no adequately supported ambiguity stratum remains, patient/case provenance or physical alignment fails, or no_M0 retains an M0-derived path. These failures make the mechanism non-identifiable and do not authorize rerunning OOF M0.

experiments.comparison: Minimum causal intervention allowed by the frozen first-paper matrix: train and evaluate the canonical simple-first full arm versus the exhaustive no_M0 ablation on identical episodes. The intervention changes only availability of explicit M0-derived information; polarity-blind and geometry-only remain diagnostic arms and cross-attention is excluded.
held_constant: patient-disjoint train/validation/test split and identical case and episode hashes
signed scribble masks, polarity, geometry descriptors, labels, episode type, sampling weights, and construction seeds
all non-M0 channels plus identical tensor shape and preprocessing
simple 17-channel-compatible backbone, state/cue-support pooling, geometry MLP, and joint/operation/target/scope heads
initialization policy, seed set, minibatch order, optimizer, schedule, regularization, training budget, early stopping, and checkpoint selection
six-joint legality handling, primary endpoint, patient aggregation, missing-data rule, confidence procedure, and smallest relevant effect or equivalence margin, all frozen before outcome access
experiments.observable: For each held-out patient, calculate the paired full-minus-no_M0 difference on one preregistered proper six-joint endpoint, then summarize with a patient-level interval or randomization procedure. Report target and scope diagnostics in their identifiable strata, operation as a polarity-shortcut control, calibration, per-joint support, and controlled/natural slices without changing the primary. Audit zero patient overlap, identical episode manifests, exactly-one OOF M0 per case, no ground-truth/residual/post-edit input, and no M0-derived path in no_M0.
experiments.falsifier: After all validity gates pass, the directional state-information hypothesis is falsified for the canonical interface if the preregistered patient-level 95% upper confidence bound for full-minus-no_M0 improvement is at or below zero; a practically meaningful version is also rejected if the upper bound is below a nonzero smallest relevant effect fixed before unblinding. An interval spanning beneficial and null effects is inconclusive, not proof. Stop escalation and do not substitute cross-attention as a rescue.

experiments.comparison: Using only the locked predictions from the canonical matrix, compare full and no_M0 within patient-level strata matched before outcome access on polarity, geometry family, measurable stroke morphology, controlled/natural episode type, and coarse M0/error burden. Contrast adequately supported ambiguity strata, where the same cue features permit multiple legal target or scope labels, with cue-determined strata. This is an analysis of the primary intervention, not a new training arm.
held_constant: canonical checkpoints and predictions from CMC-EXP-02
patient-level grouping and paired episode identities
stratum definitions, matching variables, support thresholds, and multiplicity handling frozen before opening outcomes
target evaluated where SAME and NEW are both legal and scope evaluated only where scope is not fixed by target
unchanged six-joint mapping and primary endpoint direction
experiments.observable: Report patient-level full-minus-no_M0 target, identifiable-scope, and legal-joint differences with support counts in every prespecified stratum. A relational state mechanism predicts a coherent advantage in ambiguity strata after cue and difficulty matching; a construction shortcut predicts that any aggregate advantage is confined to operation, cue-determined, legality-determined, or difficulty-separated strata.
experiments.falsifier: The state-relative interpretation is falsified even if an aggregate score improves when no_M0 matches full in adequately powered ambiguity strata and the apparent gain is confined to operation, generator geometry, legality-determined scope, or coarse difficulty strata. This is the key mechanistic falsifier because it separates state-relative interpretation from protocol and generator decoding.

experiments.comparison: Interpret the already frozen polarity-blind and geometry-only diagnostic arms alongside full and no_M0, without promoting either diagnostic or any new fusion architecture to the primary. Use them to test whether sign or geometry alone reproduces the canonical pattern.
held_constant: same patient split, episode manifest, ontology, legality mask, and patient-level metric code
same simple-first backbone, optimization, seed policy, budget, and checkpoint-selection rule
only the named diagnostic information removal
interpretation rules frozen before outcomes
experiments.observable: Report patient-level operation, target, identifiable-scope, and legal-joint behavior. A large polarity-blind operation loss localizes sign decoding; geometry-only performance localizes generator morphology; their error patterns must be related to the full-versus-no_M0 ambiguity-stratum results rather than ranked as replacement models.
experiments.falsifier: If geometry-only reproduces full target/scope/joint behavior and no_M0 matches full after all gates, explicit state dependence is falsified for this protocol. If polarity-blind leaves operation unchanged, first treat the cue-delivery or ablation implementation as invalid rather than inventing a cognitive explanation.

blockers: BLOCKER-1 (first operational): close, hash, and verify the exact downstream deployed software bundle, environment, configuration, and F0 contract after the stale-bundle failure. Do not begin M0 evaluation or downstream fitting until closure, and do not rerun or replace the committed OOF M0 set.

BLOCKER-2 (identifiability): complete the FN/FP atlas and freeze distinct-patient support and ambiguity thresholds for all six legal joints; stop if either NEW_LOCAL joint appears, any legal joint is unsupported, or cue/generator variables deterministically expose target or scope.

BLOCKER-3 (ablation validity): freeze and audit an exhaustive inventory of every direct and derived M0 path, identical episode hashes, matched tensor and optimization paths, and zero ground-truth, residual, post-edit, patient-identity, filename, cache, padding, normalization, or sampler leakage.

BLOCKER-4 (causal analysis): precommit the patient-level primary endpoint, paired aggregation, uncertainty procedure, missing-data and multiplicity rules, equivalence or smallest-relevant-effect margin, identifiable slot strata, and key ambiguity-stratified falsifier before outcome access.

BLOCKER-5 (domain validity): verify patient/exam identity, duplicate and longitudinal-study handling, case-to-M0 binding, PET/CT/reference/M0/residual/scribble physical-coordinate alignment, acquisition and label provenance, and missingness before scientific interpretation.

CLAIM BOUNDARY: a positive canonical contrast can support incremental M0 information for protocol-generated labels only; it cannot establish that M0 causes intent or validate real human cognition without a separately approved human-interaction study.

SCOPE-DRIFT STOP: cross-attention, FiLM, gated fusion, and PET-to-CT modality fusion remain separately registered deferred ablations or future work. Promoting cross-attention to the first-paper primary, using it to rescue a falsified/null canonical result, or retrospectively redefining full is prohibited scope drift.

TRUTH BOUNDARY: no v2 training, inference, metric, effect estimate, comparator result, publication conclusion, or live-server state is available; do not convert this design contribution, scripts, checkpoints, or OOF readiness into a scientific result.
